ownerReview: 接受 Phase 3a-B G-A8 正式 STOP 結果，選擇方案 A，但本輪先做有界限的平衡修正研究。
1. 保留已凍結版本 7a6e9736 與 G-A8 全部證據，不覆寫、不重新判定。
2. 優先診斷 hard_engage_stack、three_lane_pressure、classic.m6 的過強原因。先利用既有比賽、引擎機制及模板設定分析，確認是否有共同根因，不要直接盲調數值。
3. 根據診斷結果，事前登記一輪有限候選篩選，使用新的開發期 Seeds，交獨立 Reviewer 審查後執行。
4. 修正必須保留三個模板的核心玩法。尤其 three_lane_pressure 不能單純移除三路壓制來換取 PASS；classic.m6 只能做 v21 限定修正，v20 完全不變。
5. 同時分析 m5、m1、m3 接近 STOP 的風險，以及 defensive_hold 24.8% 對玩家體驗的影響，但不無限制擴充篩選。
6. 這輪以一次有界限的候選研究為上限。若找不到兼顧平衡與戰術特色的方案，停止並提出產品決策選項，不再自行追加下一輪。
Seeds 政策：43001–43400 已觀察，不可重作正式確認。新候選使用獨立、事前登記且去重的開發期 Seeds。其他尚未使用的正式保留 Seeds 全部保留。若未來修正語意，必須重新凍結並建立新的正式驗收登記。
本輪不重新凍結、不跑完整 P2、不重錄 Golden、不改發布門檻。保留 Challenge v21 STOP，兩個發布旗標關閉。不 Push、不 Deploy、不整合 main、不修改 CS。

diagnosis: review/tactic-book-3a/3a-B_平衡修正研究.md section 2. Summary, from committed results and the engine, no match run: (1) across 42 template-block points the win rate relative to std correlates with aggression r=0.90, R2 0.81 (observational: aggressive templates also carry aggressive content). (2) Experimentally on std content, the knob study gives about +1.1 pp per +0.1 aggression (0.4..1.9) and +1.5 pp per +0.1 risk (0.4..2.5). (3) The engine: engageBias and phaseEngage add to the fight-entry score, riskTolerance lowers the emergency retreat floor and the commit threshold; neither changes damage, and neither has an explicit cost (LogicEngine.js 3040, 3046, 2714). (4) All three formal STOP templates sit at aggression 0.7 and risk 0.6-0.7: the two knob slopes alone predict about +5 pp, close to the +6..+7 pp they sit above std. (5) three_lane_pressure differs: knob study K +3.25 not distinguished, label CONTENT_DRIVEN, and round 4 needed the lanes to separate, which the Owner has ruled out as the fix. These are hypotheses for the arm list, not evidence of a fix

identityRule: Owner item 4. candidateRules: every numeric value stays inside the range the eight classic templates and three overlays already cover; enum values are existing values
the resolved engine knobs of every candidate differ from every other template and every other candidate
only the declared fields differ from the template (V2)
thresholds: the G-A8 rules, unchanged: STOP = win rate >= 0.60 and lower 95% bound > 0.55; WARN strong >= 0.57; WARN weak <= 0.43; control 0.50 +/- 0.05
selectionRule: unchanged from rounds 1-5: a candidate qualifies only inside the band 0.43 < win rate < 0.57; SELECTED = the first qualifying candidate in the listed order with 0.45 <= win rate <= 0.55; qualifying only in 0.43-0.45 or 0.55-0.57 => SELECTED_BORDERLINE; none => NO_CANDIDATE
listed order (listedOrder, asserted by V2), by size of change: HE_A, HE_B, HE_C; TLP_E, TLP_F, TLP_G; M6_A, M6_B, M6_C; M5_A; M1_B. Fixed before the run

SHOWS_IMPROVEMENT = paired vsBase upper 95% bound < 0, unadjusted. FIRST_DISTINGUISHED = the first candidate in the listed order with that property. The report also gives a Bonferroni label over the 11 candidates (|z| >= 2.84), descriptive only
BASE not reproduced on this block: the formal STOP stands regardless, so the candidate is still assessed (screenedCandidate, boundedOutcome). The formal G-A8 result is not re-judged

boundedOutcome, computed by the tool for each template, fixed before the run. REASONABLE = the screened candidate SHOWS_IMPROVEMENT, or FIRST_DISTINGUISHED is inside the band. Otherwise NO_REASONABLE_CANDIDATE. A BORDERLINE arm always goes to the Owner as an explicit decision

study outcome: CANDIDATES_FOR_ALL_STOPS when all of stopTargets are REASONABLE; otherwise PRODUCT_DECISION_NEEDED, with the templates listed. INSTRUMENT (control out of range or more than 1% errors) or INCONCLUSIVE: stop and report; only the Owner may re-run this same registration unchanged. Whatever the outcome this is the last round; nothing is added after seeing data
the tool outcome is a proposal: an accepted candidate is a v21 fix candidate only, by Owner decision including its copy, and needs a new freeze and a new formal acceptance on fresh confirmation seeds
nearStopAnalysis: classic.m5, m1 and m3: BASE arms give a new read; pooled with earlier blocks in the report (descriptive) and turned into a chance of a STOP at n=400. M5_A and M1_B are one bounded arm each. classic.m3 gets no candidate: its frozen fix stays as it is
defensiveHoldAnalysis: no arm. Rounds 1-2 already tried it (DH_A, DH_B, DH_C and others, none improved). Analysis only, from committed results: review/tactic-book-3a/3a-B_平衡修正研究.md section 3
report: per arm: win rate, 95% CI, G-A8 label, blue / red, STANDARD / SWAPPED, median duration, paired difference to STD; mechanism means (kill difference, gold lead at 10 and 20 min, towers taken and lost)
per candidate: paired difference to BASE with 95% CI, Bonferroni label, confirmation risks
per template: BASE against the formal result; verdict, screened candidate, boundedOutcome

multiplicity and power: 11 candidates on one block, unadjusted 95% intervals; paired sd about 0.69 gives an MDE of about 6.8 pp at n=800, so a NO_REASONABLE_CANDIDATE can be a false negative and a SELECTED rate carries winner's curse

validation.V1: the STD and BASE arms on the first 10 screening seeds reproduce the same configs through the binding path: win and duration identical (BASE_classic.m3 against the frozen table)
validation.V2: every candidate is valid, inside the shipped range, distinct after resolution, and differs only in the declared fields; 18 arms; the candidate order equals listedOrder
validation.V2b: a BASE arm that declares values must equal the frozen table of its template
validation.V3: V3a every candidate resolves to engine knobs that differ from its BASE; V3b on the validate matches the t=0 Director probe (v3) equals each arm's expectation

liveCheck: every record: balanceTool.v21, Director core.v1, laneFrame teamRelative, skills on, talents off, and the t=0 Director probe equals the arm's expectation; any mismatch => HALT
errors: errored matches are never retried; more than 1% errored => STOP(INSTRUMENT)
fingerprint: 0cc52b48cfb9348a (frozen at 7a6e9736; the tool refuses to run on another fingerprint)
matches: 18 arms x 800 = 14,400 (about 5.5 h at 1.37 s per match measured in the formal G-A8, 3 workers); single line; resumes in the same folder
notClaimed: no template is changed; the formal G-A8 stays STOP and its evidence stays as it is; no fix is confirmed by this study; a candidate says nothing about a table template combined with a player choice (NOT TESTED)
checkpointing: per match; resume in the same folder; no commit while it runs
outOfScope: other templates, the two knobs of templates not listed, every locked field, the engine, thresholds, the frozen table entries, Challenge. A cost on the engage channel in the engine is out of scope: it would be a shared engine change
